title: Anthropic deploys Claude Sonnet 5, Fable and Mythos restored
summary: Anthropic has successfully relaunched Claude Sonnet 5 and restored access to its Fable and Mythos frontier AI models after completing a federal export control review, ending an 18-day operational pause that began on June 12 when a US government directive temporarily suspended their highest-capability systems.
problem_solved: Resolves the temporary suspension of Anthropic's most advanced AI capabilities caused by US government export control regulations.
why_valuable: Marks the completion of regulatory compliance for one of the leading AI companies, restoring access to frontier-level AI models for users and demonstrating successful navigation of government oversight frameworks.
